g.text: 1. ORIENTATION
"hello, I'm Ama,
your nurse — this is
how we'll work"
2. WORKING
assess, plan, act,
teach, counsel —
trust deepens!
3. TERMINATION
summarise, plan,
say goodbye —
transfer trust!
3 PHASES (Peplau — exam core!): orientation (introduce + contract + first trust) →
working (the care itself: assess, teach, counsel, confront kindly) → termination (summarise
gains + discharge plan + goodbye + referral). Skipped orientation = stranger-care; skipped
termination = abandonment feelings. Even 5-minute contacts run all three!
GOALS of therapeutic talk: trust + understanding (their story, beliefs, fears) + informed
decisions + coping + adherence + dignity. Social chat pleases; therapeutic talk HEALS —
every conversation aims at a patient outcome.
ROLES you play (Peplau!): stranger (respect!) → resource (answers) → teacher (skills) →
counsellor (feelings) → surrogate (stand-in strength) → leader (direction). Match the role to
the phase: orienting strangers need welcome, not lectures.
EMPATHY vs SYMPATHY (exam favourite!): empathy = "I hear how frightening this is for you"
(WITH them, their shoes); sympathy = "oh poor you, I feel so bad" (ABOVE them, your feelings).
Empathy heals; sympathy distances. Never "I know how you feel" — you don't.
TRUST FORMULA: competence (know your work!) + honesty (admit limits!) + consistency (same
nurse, same story!) + respect (their values!) + time (sit down!). Trust builds in drops,
breaks in buckets — one lie, one mockery, one abandonment empties it.
NON-THERAPEUTIC FLAGS: false reassurance ("you'll be fine!") · advice-giving ("if I were
you…") · judging ("you should have come earlier") · changing subject · defending ("the
doctor is busy!") · probing. Exams QUIZ these — spot the worst response!
LINKS: PRO-I M3 boundaries + consent · GER M3 dignity · NUT M1 counsel chain.
MANTRA: "orient warmly, work honestly, end kindly — every contact, all three."
